title: Marvelous Designer 2025.1: Pattern Drafter (Beta)
description:
Users can now generate patterns based on their selection of clothing type. They can easily adjust the values, save, and load them. In addition, they can seamlessly create patterns from any uploaded image.

Note that the AI feature is turned off by default. To toggle it on, please follow the steps as below:
For individual users:
Log in to our official website, then go to My Account page, nevigate to Account tag, scroll down to AI Studio Plug-in  option, then switch on it.
(Link: https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/mypage/account)
For enterprise users:
Since AI functions are controlled by company ID for enterprise users, you need to get contact with the administrator of your Company ID. Log in to our official website with your company ID, then go to Team Console page, nevigate to AI Studio tag, then switch on the AI functions for each End User account.
(Link: https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/teamconsole/ai-studio)
